title: Defender Attack Surface Reduction (ASR) Rules are Unconfigured or in Audit Mode
description: Attack Surface Reduction rules target behaviors that malware frequently uses, such as executable content creation by Office apps, script obfuscation, and child process spawning.
expected: Core ASR rules enabled in Block mode (Action = 1)
impact: Malicious macro documents and weaponized Office payloads can spawn interpreters (cmd.exe, powershell.exe) unchecked.
remediation_guidance: Enable core ASR rules in block mode: Add-MpPreference -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Ids <RuleID> -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Actions Enabled
